newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers prices slip on poor enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers prices slip on poor enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices slipped further on Friday on lack of buying interest, traders said.

But traders said there is likely a limit to the slide in prices as cargo levels were high. Sellers said they were caught by high cargo prices and poor bunker demand. "We cannot lower offers too much or we would be making a loss," said a major.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $101-102 per tonne and 380-cst at $94-95, down about a dollar from Thursday. MDO and gas oil were quoted around $198-$203 and $210-$215 respectively.
